name: MITRE ATLAS
source_version: content v2026.06; ATLAS data format v6 line
allowed_use_boundary: Use as external adversarial AI threat-knowledge crosswalk evidence.
Preserve MITRE ATLAS-native terminology and distinguish content version from data-format version.
Use tactics, techniques, mitigations, case studies, and relationship data as threat-context evidence only.
Do not treat as certification, endorsement, execution authority, standing, or commit-time authority.
claims: MITRE ATLAS can support adversarial AI tactic, technique, mitigation, case-study, and relationship comparison.
The pinned v2026.06 release provides an immutable public release identity for the source-level crosswalk.
MITRE ATLAS can be mapped to threat-informed review, evidence posture, drift, policy reference, and fail-closed review terms.
non_claims: MITRE ATLAS does not prove transition admissibility.
MITRE ATLAS does not grant execution authority inside StegVerse.
Threat classification or mitigation mapping does not establish actor standing, delegation, or consequence-binding authority.
The StegVerse compatibility fixture is a bounded simulation/crosswalk test and is not a claim that MITRE executed StegVerse tests.
